rationale: The failed-opening distribution thesis is intact and uninvalidated — price remains ~0.8% below VWAP and below the 9-EMA, and the bounce off 33.30 has stalled for five candles on declining volume (4.3k→3.2k) just under the 9-EMA at 33.51, which reads as a corrective pause rather than impulsive buying. Risk to the 33.57 invalidation is ~21 bps versus ~95 bps of room to the 33.16 gap-fill target, so the trade still carries favorable asymmetry. Flipping long would contradict the 6.5x-volume distribution structure and the mildly risk-off tape, and closing would abandon a live setup whose stop has not been breached.
